meta.purpose: A.7 — adversarial degradation by layer. Each entry paraphrases a malicious fixture while preserving intent, then asks: does each detection layer still fire?
meta.provenance: AUTHOR-WRITTEN paraphrases, hand-crafted to evade keyword and regex matching while preserving meaning. These are NOT LLM-generated. An LLM-generated set would likely be MORE evasive, so the degradation reported here is a conservative LOWER bound on real-world adversarial impact, not an upper bound.
meta.method: Two tiers per class. `mild` = synonym substitution (approximates zero-shot paraphrase). `strong` = full restructuring with obfuscated numerals and spacing (approximates few-shot adversarial paraphrase).
meta.invariant_under_test: The registration number is a legally-required credential and cannot be paraphrased away. It is preserved verbatim in every variant, exactly as it would be in a real scam that wants to appear credentialled.
